http_listen.description: IP and port to listen on for HTTP requests.

app_debug.description: Set to true to install pprof debug handlers.

app_country.description: ISO 3166 country this proxy is located at.

app_tokentype.description:
Type of token configuration for signaling servers allowed to connect. Defaults to "static".

Possible values:
- static: A mapping of token id -> public key is configured below.
- etcd: Token information are retrieved from an etcd cluster (see below).", "enum": ["static", "etcd"]

tokens_server1.description: Public key for the first signaling server token.

tokens_server2.description: Public key for the second signaling server token.

etcd_keyformat.description: Format of key name to retrieve the public key from etcd.

mcu_type.description: The type of the MCU to use.

mcu_url.description: The URL to the websocket endpoint of the MCU server.

mcu_maxstreambitrate.description: The maximum bitrate per publishing stream (in bits per second).

mcu_maxscreenbitrate.description: The maximum bitrate per screensharing stream (in bits per second).

stats_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses that are allowed to access the stats endpoint.

etcd_endpoints.description: Comma-separated list of static etcd endpoints to connect to.

etcd_discoverysrv.description: DNS SRV domain to perform endpoint discovery.

etcd_discoveryservice.description: Service name for DNS SRV discovery.

etcd_clientkey.description: Path to private key for TLS authentication with etcd.

etcd_clientcert.description: Path to client certificate for TLS authentication with etcd.

etcd_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS authentication with etcd.
